voiceSummary: Globe International Carriers Limited has published a newspaper advertisement in Financial Express and Business Remedies on 16 November 2026. This notice concerns the approval of financial results by the Board of Directors during their meeting held on 14 November 2026. The company submitted this intimation to the National Stock Exchange of India under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The announcement serves to inform exchange members and investors regarding the finalized financial outcomes.
